name: fz556_prankster_curse_dark
purpose: Mega Banette, with Prankster, uses Curse on Sharpedo (step 2): the Prankster test of hitStepTryImmunity (sim/battle-actions.ts:676-684) comes before the onHit, so Sharpedo is -immune and Banette pays no HP. On main the engine took half of Banette's HP, so Scale Shot knocked it out after one hit and the step stopped with E_INVARIANT (issue 556). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_380_44), whole. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
